snippet.title: Your new corporate job is a nightmare | Company is Watching - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist & Play the DEMO here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4431090/Company_is_watching/

WELCOME TO THE BIG FAMILY.
Dear new employee, we are thrilled to welcome you to our production line. Here, your mission is simple, repetitive, and essential: maintain our quotas. Let yourself be lulled by the routine. Obey the instructions. Screw, clean, and destroy what you are told to destroy.

Optimization is our priority.

3 scary games, fnaf inspired, iron lung vibe, psychological horror playthrough, weird indie games, dystopian horror
